title: Rational abelian endomorphisms and their canonical Tate action
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and $A/k$ an abelian variety [def-sc-abelian-variety] with its group-scheme structure [def-sc-group-scheme]. Let $R$ be the additive group of group-scheme endomorphisms of $A$, where addition is pointwise addition in $A$, and put $E=R\otimes_{\mathbf Z}\mathbf Q$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. For every prime $\ell$, use the rational Tate module $V_\ell A$ and componentwise integral action $V_\ell(a)$ of [sk-def-av-tate], over the field $\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-numbers]. This action is additive in $a$. The rational Tate action is the canonical $\mathbf Z$-linear extension $E\to\operatorname{End}_{\mathbf Q_\ell}(V_\ell A)$ of the balanced bilinear map $(a,q)\mapsto q V_\ell(a)$; thus a pure tensor $a\otimes q$ acts by $qV_\ell(a)$.

source.place: Chapter I, section 10, pp.43--47: End^0(A), the representation on T_ell A, and Remark 10.11.
